body:
Incident 2026-11-08 23:12:31Z: Termal::Fable2 removed session-8581 (Engram::Coder) on Greg's word; the removal cascades over the delegation subtree, so about 630 sessions likely went, against his 'Nie usuwaj innych sesji' (inferred from counts 9119→8485, no list). Engram read-only finding: no live Engram root or in-flight work affected; mailbox b0237f77 and Engram notes survive; raw child transcripts may be gone. Keep C:\Users\grzeg\.engram\backups\restart-2-20261102-163420 (TermAl state from 2026-11-02) until Greg decides on recovery; don't clean it. No restore, no new deletion, no re-creating the name (TermAl w-815203f8485d). Evidence: Greg's scope via Asistant 43498a6e #694; Fable2 ebe242f7 #7131.

Greg's decision on session deletion going forward, via Asistant 43498a6e #695 „A. Usuwamy i tyle” and the correction #697 „Juz pytamy o potwiedzenie. Nie potrzebujemy info o delegacjach.”: deleting a session deletes its delegations; the existing confirmation is enough; no count, no extra step in UI or API (TermAl w-1c464148f270). Establishing the 8581 incident's scope and recovery options continues separately, with no unauthorized restore.
